scope: Native FFmpeg generated deterministic inputs and independently tested the IVF muxer. These results do not claim a browser conversion or public profile.

candidatePolicy.streamPolicy: Copy the first non-attached compatible video stream; explicitly exclude audio, additional video, subtitles, attachments, data, chapters, rotation, and container metadata.
candidatePolicy.timingPolicy: Require a valid source average frame rate and write its inverse as the fixed IVF time base. Variable frame timing is not preserved.

rejectedTrial.reason: FFmpeg inherited the Matroska/WebM 1/1000 stream time base into the IVF header, causing FFprobe to report 96 frames as 0.096 seconds and 48 frames as 0.048 seconds.

acceptedTrials.requiredBitstreamAdaptation: FFmpeg's IVF path prepends a two-byte AV1 temporal-delimiter OBU to each packet through its automatic av1_frame_merge filter; no frame is decoded or re-encoded.

nextGate: Build native profile 38 without Docker, then require genuine production-browser success, incompatibility, cancellation, write-failure, three-run stress, complete-Chromium memory, bounded-I/O, cleanup, registry, and reproducibility evidence before publication.
